name: FIJI Water
verdict: FIJI Water is a brand of The Wonderful Company LLC — a privately held US company. Nothing found.
note: Naming-rights sponsor of the Flying Fijians (front of the home shirt) since 2023, under a multimillion-dollar deal running towards the 2027 Rugby World Cup (Fiji Rugby sponsors page; fijivillage 14 April 2023). No state or fund in the ownership chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against The Wonderful Company found.
